sane: The database now tracks races, racial abilities, classes, maps, areas and every spell's effect values, each with its history
The database took this build and its hotfixes: 67 new and 458 changed items, 16 new and 332 changed spells, 97 talents, 86 recipes, 28 Legacy nodes, 15 racial abilities and 2 flights
Navigation's walking data was made anew for both continents and Zephras Isle
Abilities' spellbook window follows the game's narrower one; the settings' colour picker and the bags take what is new
62 pictures of the map are queued to be painted again from this build's terrain

points.text: Everything here is compared with build 70245, the last build our database and map were read from
The interface alone is compared with build 70532, the export before this one.
Mace Specialization is replaced by Artisan's Precision: spell and attack hit chance increased by 1%
points.was: critical chance increased by 1% with Maces

points.text: Find Treasure's short line now adds a chance to find more valuables in chests
Eureka!: reduced cost and 10% more damage or healing now lasts 8 seconds
points.was: on the next 3 spells or abilities

points.text: Read Ley Line is renamed Read Leyline: Health and Mana regeneration increased by 50% for 15 seconds
Its cast time is now 0.5 seconds (was 2 seconds)
Wind Blessed: Haste increased by 2%
Walk on Air cooldown reduced to 1.5 minutes
Sword Specialization is replaced by Ruthless: critical chance increased by 1%
The Human Spirit: Spirit increased by 10%
Axe Specialization is replaced by Command: Hunter and Warlock pets deal 5% more damage
points.was: critical chance increased by 1% with Axes

points.text: Shatter Curse now removes Banes and Curses and reduces Magical damage taken by 5%
Endurance no longer increases Hit Chance by 1%; it still increases total Health by 5%
Plainsrunning now stacks movement speed while moving
points.was: Self and Party movement speed increased by 2%

points.text: Cultivation now has a 15-minute cooldown
War Stomp cooldown reduced to 1.5 minutes
Regeneration: 20% of Health regeneration continues in combat, and it is increased by 20% at all times
Skysight: movement speed increased by 15% for 15 seconds
Wind Blessed: Haste increased by 2%
Walk on Air cooldown reduced to 1.5 minutes
Wild Growth now has a 3-second cast time at every rank
Primal Bite's weapon damage value increased: rank 1 to 42 (was 26), rank 3 to 77 (was 59)
Shred's weapon damage value reduced to 22
Thorns damage reduced at every rank: rank 1 to 3 (was 4), rank 6 to 18 (was 22)
Bear Form's threat bonus increased to 50%
Wrath gains less damage per level: rank 1 to 0.2 (was 0.4)
Ferocious Bite gains a new first rank, for 6 ranks in all
Lacerate gains two new first ranks, for 5 ranks in all
Shifting Power cooldown reduced to 8 seconds
Swiftmend's description now says your own Rejuvenation or Regrowth must be on the target
Berserk and Improved Shifting Power are no longer talents
Primal Bite takes Berserk's place, Lacerate takes Primal Bite's, Predatory Discipline takes Shifting Power's, and Shifting Power takes Improved Shifting Power's
Bloom replaces Gift of the Earthmother, and Predatory Instincts is renamed Natural Instinct
Furor swaps places with Heart of the Wild, and Reflection with Subtlety
Immolation Trap and Explosive Trap lose the word Effect from their names at every rank
Sonic Blast (pet) cooldown increased to 1 minute at every rank
Aspect of the Hawk's ranged attack power reduced at every rank: rank 1 to 15 (was 20), rank 5 to 47 (was 90)
Trueshot Aura rank 1 now gives 15
Improved Revive Pet and Pathfinding moved in the talent tree
Arcane Blast cast time reduced to 1.5 seconds at every rank
Its base damage falls with it: rank 1 to 32 (was 54), rank 5 to 236 (was 394)
Fireball's top rank hits harder and its first gains less per level: rank 5 base damage 120 (was 108), rank 1 per level 0.2 (was 0.6)
Ice Lance now has an 8-second cooldown at every rank
Precision, renamed from Elemental Precision, now has 3 ranks
Fire Power now has 3 ranks
Incineration now has 5 ranks
Improved Fireball is renamed Accelerant, and Wake of Fire is renamed Improved Fire Blast
Missile Barrage and Arcane Resilience swap places in the talent tree
Improved Blizzard, Frost Channeling, Frostbite and Permafrost moved
Holy Shield mana cost reduced to 100, 150 and 195 by rank, with a new fourth rank
Its effect value falls too: rank 1 to 75 (was 110), rank 3 to 153 (was 221)
Righteous Fury's threat bonus increased to 90%
Retribution Aura damage reduced at every rank: rank 1 to 5 (was 7), rank 5 to 20 (was 30)
Light's Vigil range increased to 40 yards at every rank
Swift Judgement now has a 10-yard range and its own description
New talents: Turn Evil, Divine Strength and Boundless Light
Oath of Light replaces Voice of Truth, Stoicism replaces Divine Strength, Shieldsworn replaces Improved Seal of Fury, and Unsealed Wrath replaces Twist of Light
More ranks: Improved Seals 5 (was 3), Spiritual Focus 5 (was 2), Champion of the Light 5 (was 3)
Fewer ranks: Divine Precision 2 (was 3), Reverence 2 (was 3), Shield Specialization 2 (was 3), Conviction 3 (was 5), Iron Creed 3 (was 5)
All three talent trees are rearranged, with 38 talents changed
Devouring Plague cooldown reduced to 24 seconds at every rank
Vampiric Embrace cooldown reduced to 30 seconds
Shadow Word: Death cooldown increased to 18 seconds at every rank
Penance mana cost increased to 150, 220 and 385 by rank
Heal amount reduced: rank 1 to 270 (was 291), rank 2 to 375 (was 405)
Lesser Heal gains less per level, and rank 3 heals for 163
Smite gains less damage per level at every rank: rank 1 to 0.1 (was 0.5)
Holy Fire rank 1 base damage reduced to 54
Dark Inspiration replaces Improved Fade with 5 ranks, Improved Mind Blast replaces Shadow Affinity with 5 ranks, and Holy Binding replaces Binding Heal
Chain Lightning mana cost reduced to 145, 200, 250 and 315 by rank
Fire Nova mana cost reduced to 65, 120, 210, 290 and 375 by rank
Lava Burst mana cost reduced to 135, 165 and 230 by rank
Rank 1 base damage falls to 123 (was 164)
Lightning Bolt gains less damage per level, and rank 5 base damage rises to 82
Mana Tide Totem mana cost reduced to 20 and 30 by rank
Lava Burst, Elemental Mastery, Earthbound and Lightning Overload are rearranged in the talent tree
Improved Fire Nova is renamed Trial by Fire, Elemental Warding swaps with Elemental Alacrity, and Totemic Focus with Tidal Focus
Portal of Summoning cooldown increased to 1 hour
Grim Reach replaces Malediction, with 2 ranks
Furious Precision replaces Boundless Rage, and Lingering Rage replaces Iron Will
Bloodthirst's value increased to 45 at every rank
The talent trees are rearranged, with 15 talents changed
Grubbis's difficulty value changes to 1
Shade of the Archmage and Rath'mael move later in their instance's boss order
67 items added, among them Thunderfury, Sulfuras, Benediction, Anathema and Rhok'delar under new item numbers
A set of Elixirs and Scrolls of Endless effects, and Noggenfogger Elixir, Superior Healing Potion and Superior Mana Potion
New items for jewelry and weapons such as Choker of the Fire Lord, Quick Strike Ring and Earthshaker
Battleground Marks of Honor now stack to 30, for all four battlegrounds
Intact Limbs now stack to 50
Potion of Predatory Senses, renamed from Draught, now lasts 1.5 minutes
The Lesser Intellect effect now lasts 30 minutes
Tomes such as Tome of Arcane Domination and items such as Lei of the Lifegiver and The Immovable Object drop to item level 60
Weapon speed: Whisper 3.4 (was 3.2), Abandoned Ferocity 3.2 (was 2.7), Rage of the Storm 3.2 (was 3.6)
458 items changed in all: 144 sell prices, most of them lower, 92 item levels, 91 qualities, 57 names and 42 required levels
Every one stands in the list of every change at the foot of this page.
Replica Dartol's Rod of Transformation is now a toy
The challenge Play in the WoW: Forever Beta now rewards 1
The Legacy trees are rearranged, with 27 perks moved
New enchant: Enchant Boots - Speed, with its formula
New plans and patterns teach chain and leather armor, and new formulas teach the Hearts of the Mountain
34 recipes change the skill where they turn yellow, and 30 where they turn grey
Recipes that make shoulders now say Shoulders in their names
Guardians of Hyjal has a new description
The Forever Experience Preset is now set by two calls, one before and one after login
New: a pet's pending move order can be read, with an event when it changes, and an event when a settings header changes
Loss of Control data follows a new restriction on what addons can read during it
The game's spellbook window is narrower
Bag slots gain their own empty-slot icon, and item buttons gain a mask
116 interface code files and 3 pictures changed
Western Kalimdor was reshaped: the ground rose or fell by up to 125 yards around Mulgore, Desolace, The Barrens, Thunder Bluff and Shen'dralas, and up to 31 yards around Stonetalon Mountains
Water changed in Felwood, Ashenvale, Mount Hyjal, Stonetalon Mountains and The Barrens
Smaller changes to the ground in the Eastern Kingdoms: up to 35 yards around Eastern Plaguelands, 21 yards around Tirisfal Glades, and 7 yards around Wetlands, Loch Modan and Dun Morogh
New areas: Dreambound Pinnacle, Twilight Hollow, Hyjal Crater and Sunken Hollow
New maps: Dalaran Skycuter and Mulgore Skycuter
Hyjal Crater's map now counts as a world map
Doodads moved across Duskwood, Wetlands, Loch Modan, Dun Morogh and Stranglethorn Vale, and 15 buildings and 19 models changed
A quest flight path is added on Zephras Isle at the Spires Wind Bridge, and two flight paths are a little shorter
Dalaran's area now counts as Alliance, and Timbermaw Hold's mount rules changed
The Darkmoon Faire's dates now stand in the client

sane: The database took this build and its hotfixes: 14 new and 139 changed spells, 3 new and 42 changed talents, 7 class skill lines, 1 new and 6 changed items; 2 spells, 1 talent, 1 achievement and 1 option gone
Social's contacts menu offers your broadcast in Retail alone, as Forever's own took it out; a friend's game icon shows Forever's sub icon
Nameplates' combat text writes Forever's hidden amounts as they are, and a blow blocked, absorbed or resisted whole as its word
The settings' option labels and Sync's pages no longer list Broadcast Updates
Nothing in the world moved, so no walking data or painting of the map was made anew

points.text: Everything here is compared with build 70707, the build before, each with the hotfixes the game held that day
Blizzard has published no patch notes or hotfixes for WoW: Forever for this build; looked for on 2026-11-03.
The achievement Played in the WoW: Forever Beta is gone
High Order Skyborne and Windshaper Skyborne characters' customization now lists Feathers before Feather Color
Command gets an icon and a second effect of 5%
The counters of class talent resets and Legacy talent resets now recharge every 7 days
Claw now deals 140% weapon damage at every rank
Shred now deals 200% weapon damage at every rank
Ravage now deals 435% weapon damage at every rank
Rake hits harder at every rank: rank 1 deals 27 and 20 a tick (was 23 and 16), rank 4 76 and 42 (was 61 and 34)
Rip deals more a tick at every rank: rank 1 4 (was 3), rank 6 19 (was 15)
Ferocious Bite's damage and the damage each extra point of Energy adds increase at every rank: rank 1 17 and 70 (was 14 and 60), rank 6 102 and 330 (was 82 and 270)
Starfire's damage increases at every rank: rank 1 113 (was 81), rank 7 533 (was 381), and it gains more a level
New passive Poised: at full Energy and out of combat, your next ability costs less Energy
Aimed Shot's bonus damage roughly doubles at every rank: rank 1 40 (was 20), rank 6 350 (was 166)
Sniper Shot's bonus damage doubles at every rank: rank 1 320 (was 160), rank 3 590 (was 295)
Arcane Shot's damage increases at every rank: rank 1 25 (was 20), rank 8 280 (was 217)
Serpent Sting deals more a tick at every rank: rank 1 3 (was 2), rank 9 135 (was 111)
Aspect of the Hawk's ranged attack power increases at every rank: rank 1 20 (was 15), rank 6 110 (was 55)
Trueshot Aura's attack power increases at every rank: rank 1 20 (was 15), rank 3 50 (was 30), rank 5 100 (was 50)
Holy Shield rank 4 now costs 240 mana and has a 10-second cooldown, as its other ranks do
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization now increases Holy damage too
The talent trees are reworked: 7 talents become new ones, 2 talents get places of their own, Improved Distract is removed and 21 talents move
Death Mark replaces Thousand Cuts: a finishing move that marks the target and stores part of the damage your attacks deal to it, per combo point, then deals it when the mark ends, up to a cap
Garrote and Rupture are stored at twice the rate
25 Energy, 20 yards, a 10-second cooldown, 4 ranks
New ability Shank: an off-hand strike for 50% weapon damage that cannot miss and gives 15 Energy, for 5 Energy, with a 10-second cooldown
A second form of it gives 25 Energy
Boot Knife replaces Cutthroat: Shank gets a chance to add combo points
Flash of Steel takes Dual Wield Specialization's place: Shank gives more Energy and has a shorter cooldown
Dual Wield Specialization moves to a place of its own with 2 ranks
Venom now works through Shank: Shank raises your Poison damage and your chance to apply Poisons for a while
Quick Getaway replaces Quietus: one more target can be Sapped, and Sapping gives 35% movement speed for a while, 2 ranks
Vigor replaces Murder: more maximum Energy, 2 ranks
Blood Splatter replaces Vigor: Rupture lasts 4 seconds longer and Garrote 6 seconds
Composure takes Relentless Strikes' place: Poised lowers Energy costs further, 2 ranks
Relentless Strikes moves to a new place with 5 ranks
Coup de Grace, renamed from Improved Eviscerate, now also raises Death Mark's damage and storage rate by 20%
The former Coup de Grace, more Eviscerate damage against targets with your Deadly Poison, is gone
Efficient Strikes is the new name of Improved Sinister Strike
Ghostly Strike now also lets your next Ambush or Garrote be used without Stealth
Mutilate loses its first rank: the talent teaches the former rank 2, and its ranks are numbered 1 to 3
Flawless Execution now lowers Eviscerate's cost by 15 Energy
Seal Fate now has 3 ranks (was 5), Lethality 2 (was 5), Camouflage 3 (was 5), and Opportunity 5 (was 2)
Improved Distract is removed
New passive Poised: at full Energy and out of combat, your next ability costs less Energy
The top ranks of Poisons get more charges: Instant Poison VI 250 (was 175), Deadly Poison IV and Wound Poison IV 240 (was 160), Deadly Poison V 240 (was 180), Mind-numbing Poison III 225 (was 150)
Lightning Bolt's damage increases at every rank: rank 1 16 (was 15), rank 10 353 (was 196), and from rank 4 on it gains more a level
Chain Lightning now has a 2.5-second cast at every rank, costs more mana and deals far more damage: rank 1 215 for 245 mana (was 88 for 145), rank 4 510 for 495 (was 123 for 315)
Earth Shock's damage increases at every rank: rank 1 20 (was 18), rank 7 531 (was 301)
Flame Shock's hit and its damage over time increase: rank 1 hits for 25 (was 20), rank 6 for 292 and 80 a tick (was 166 and 44)
Frost Shock's damage increases at every rank: rank 1 98 (was 66), rank 4 506 (was 283)
Stormstrike now strikes for 150% weapon damage, with a 6-second cooldown
Riptide no longer heals at once, only over time, for less mana and with a 12-second cooldown: rank 1 150 mana (was 245), rank 3 230 (was 385)
points.was: an instant heal and a heal over time, 6 seconds

points.text: Totemic Projection is renamed Totemic Call and moves your active totems to you, with a 30-second cooldown
points.was: to a place you choose, 1 minute

points.text: Call of Thunder replaces Lava Burst in the talent tree: 5% more critical strike chance for Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning
Elemental Mastery is renamed Lightning Mastery and no longer speaks of Lava Burst
Elemental Reach no longer shortens Totemic Projection's cooldown
Improved Ghost Wolf and Improved Lightning Shield move in the talent tree
Wrack's damage now grows by 2.5 a level
Slam's cooldown is now 15 seconds at every rank
Improved Slam now shortens Slam's cooldown by 5 seconds
Improved Whirlwind replaces Raging Blows: Whirlwind's cooldown is 2 seconds shorter and it deals 30% more damage to the closest enemy, 2 ranks
points.was: Raging Blows: less Rage for Cleave and Whirlwind, 1 rank

points.text: Spearing Strike now deals 75% weapon damage, and 75% more against Giants, Dragonkin and mounted targets
New talent Reckless Swings: your next melee attacks generate extra Rage, with a 15-second cooldown
Flurry now has 3 ranks (was 5), Improved Tactical Mastery 3 (was 5), and Bloodthrill 2 (was 5)
Enrage and Gore Drinker move in the talent tree, and the arrows at Death Wish and Blood Craze change
New toy: Pouch of Violet Dust, thrown into a campfire to change its flames
Brittle Key, Stone Key, Keystone Fragment, Ancient Runestone and Dormant Runestone now go on the keyring, and the last three count as keys
Torn Page and Dormant Runestone are now unique
Letter Opener now sells for 1 silver 70 copper
Brittle Key now sells for 17 copper (was nothing)
Your Battle.net broadcast can no longer be set from the contacts menu, and the option Broadcast Updates is gone
Friends' broadcasts still show in their tooltips
The amount a unit's hit or heal took (the event UNIT_COMBAT) is now hidden from addons
Nameplate aura icons no longer show a tooltip
Friends' game icons can show which of a game's projects they play
The action bar's end caps hide when they do not fit on the screen
The Spell Damage and Spell Healing tooltips no longer say that low spell ranks trigger class abilities less often
Group Finder entries' names get less room
New for addons: whether a spell is its highest rank (C_ActionBar.IsHighestSpellRank)
63 interface code files changed, no picture
The ground, water, maps, flights and boats are unchanged
96 new light settings and 2 new kinds of weather, and some weather gets a new ambient sound
